newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav Sept producer prices 1.0 pct vs 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav Sept producer prices 1.0 pct vs 3.0 pct.

text.p: The Federal Statistical Office reported the following economic indicator details.
YUGOSLAV PRODUCER PRICES SEPT AUG SEPT 95
NOTES -- Year-on-year data compare with average for previous year, not year-ago month.
September 1996 producer prices were 79.2 percent up on September 1995.
Cummulative January-September 96 producer prices were 104.2 percent up against the same period last year, and 83.4 percent up against the average for 1995.
Figures refer to rump Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro.

The National Bank of Yugoslavia imposed a stabilisation programme on January 24, 1994, when retail price inflation was running at a monthly 313 million percent. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 2224305
